question_record.context: As part of a sign-in attempt using a deceptive user account detected on the host `vnevado-win10b` with IP address `141.216.110.153`, attackers might be using the account to perform various attack activities, including lateral movement and accessing sensitive data. Additionally, a known credential theft tool execution was detected shortly after.
question_record.question: In relation to the detected malicious credential theft tool execution, what is the IP address associated with this activity?
solution: A sign-in attempt was detected using a deceptive user account `kyleg` on host `vnevado-win10v`.
Malicious credential theft tool execution was detected coming from IP address `65.233.23.156`.

interpretation.scope: official graph witness, not a proof of causality, actor identity or autonomous planning

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Account_SID' AND o.Concept = 'Account_Name'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
